steps.name: host-qualified-self-send-exempted
steps.detail: Host-qualified self-send (fx-at1-alpha→fx-at1-alpha --host localhost --dry-run) was exempted from self-send guard. Failed with exit code 3 for a distinct reason (RemoteDeliveryUnconfirmed: mTLS peer routing issue), not SelfAddressedSendInvalid. This confirms the host qualifier correctly bypasses the self-send guard as documented.

steps.name: help-text-matches-docs
steps.detail: Help text does NOT match documentation wording. Help says: 'Route this send through the explicitly named host... This is wire-equivalent to a host-qualified recipient address.' Docs require: 'qualifies the resolved recipient as agent@team.host'. The help text conveys similar meaning but does not use the exact phrase from docs/atm/commands/send.md
